.quora-replica {
  --q-ink: #000000;
  --q-muted: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  --q-paper: #ffffff;
  --q-panel: #f7f7f7;
  --q-line: #ededed;
  --q-accent: #ff5e2b;
  --q-ease: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  --q-shared-gesture-spring: linear(0, 0.1873, 0.4978, 0.7484, 0.9025, 0.9795, 1.0091, 1.0152, 1.0123, 1.0076, 1.0038, 1.0015, 1);
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: clip;
  background: var(--q-paper);
  color: var(--q-ink);
  font-family: "Inter", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.6;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

.quora-replica,
.quora-replica *,
.quora-replica *::before,
.quora-replica *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.quora-replica :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, p, figure, blockquote) {
  margin: 0;
}

.quora-replica :where(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6) {
  font-family: "Urbanist", "Urbanist Placeholder", sans-serif;
}

.quora-replica :where(a) {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.quora-replica :where(button) {
  appearance: none;
  border: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: none;
  color: inherit;
  font: inherit;
}

.quora-replica :where(img) {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
}

.q-section {
  width: 100%;
  padding-inline: 16px;
}

.q-rise {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(20px);
  transition:
    opacity 600ms cubic-bezier(.44, .02, .22, 1) 100ms,
    transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.44, .02, .22, 1) 100ms;
}

.q-rise.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

.q-button {
  width: fit-content;
  min-height: 49.6px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.6;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 220ms ease,
    color 220ms ease,
    opacity 220ms ease;
}

.q-button--dark {
  background: var(--q-ink);
  color: #ffffff;
}

.q-button--soft {
  background: #ededed;
  color: var(--q-ink);
}

.q-button__label {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}

.q-button__icon {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 1;
  transition:
    width 400ms var(--q-shared-gesture-spring),
    opacity 400ms var(--q-shared-gesture-spring);
}

.q-button__icon--lead {
  width: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
}

.q-button--dark .q-button__icon {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .5);
}

.q-button--soft .q-button__icon {
  color: #000;
}

.q-button__icon svg {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  display: block;
  fill: currentColor;
  transition: transform 400ms var(--q-shared-gesture-spring);
}

.q-button__icon--lead svg {
  transform: translateX(-10px);
}

.q-button:focus-visible .q-button__icon--lead {
  width: 14px;
  opacity: 1;
}

.q-button:focus-visible .q-button__icon--trail {
  width: 1px;
  opacity: 0;
}

.q-button:focus-visible .q-button__icon--lead svg {
  transform: none;
}

.q-button:focus-visible .q-button__icon--trail svg {
  transform: translateX(10px);
}

@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
  .q-button:hover .q-button__icon--lead {
    width: 14px;
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .q-button:hover .q-button__icon--trail {
    width: 1px;
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .q-button:hover .q-button__icon--lead svg {
    transform: none;
  }

  .q-button:hover .q-button__icon--trail svg {
    transform: translateX(10px);
  }
}

.q-button--read-more {
  min-height: 39.6px;
  gap: 3px;
  padding: 10px 16px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.q-read-more-icon {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  flex: 0 0 18px;
}

.q-read-more-icon svg {
  width: 18px;
  height: 18px;
  display: block;
  fill: currentColor;
}

.q-button:focus-visible,
.q-faq-item button:focus-visible,
.q-story-track:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--q-accent);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}

@keyframes q-menu-in {
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
